PRESERVATION_RULE: PYQUATICUS_PORT_CONTRACT_RESULT.json is unchanged and unreinterpreted. G6_PROJECTED_REPRESENTABILITY remains FAIL, and the aggregate verdict FAIL_TEAM_EVALUATION_BLOCKED remains in force. This record does not convert any failure into a pass. It reads the per-check data the original gate already recorded and separates four independent questions that the single boolean had collapsed.
WHY_THIS_DECOMPOSITION_EXISTS: A single G6 boolean states 'the action interface cannot represent Pyquaticus semantics'. That statement is true in aggregate and materially misleading in detail: it would license redesigning ATTACK, which the same data shows is already target-exact at 0.000 cells. Three structurally different engineering problems were sharing one label.

G6_TARGET.question: Can the interface name the intended semantic target?

G6_LEGALITY.question: Is the intended semantic action legally selectable in that state?

G6_DIRECTION.question: Does execution move in the intended direction, initially and sustained?

G6_TRAJECTORY.question: Does the resulting motion stay close to the native trajectory over the frozen 16-tick horizon?
G6_TRAJECTORY.reclassification_note: Reported as its own quantity. A trajectory-fidelity failure is a cross-simulator dynamics disagreement and is NOT evidence that the action vocabulary lacks a word. The 2.5-cell threshold is NOT relaxed here; its interpretation is narrowed.

G6_TARGET.statement: Target representability failure is ENTIRELY concentrated in DEFEND. Every non-DEFEND candidate names its target within threshold, and five of them name it exactly (0.000).

G6_LEGALITY.statement: Exactly one legality defect in the entire suite: a non-carrier cannot select GO_HOME. The same semantic branch passes completely when the agent is the carrier.

G6_DIRECTION.statement: PERFECT SEPARATION: every failure is a GO_TO waypoint substitution, and every semantic macro (GET_FLAG, GO_HOME) scores 1.000 on all three direction metrics. The waypoint pathway is the direction-inverting component. Semantic macros never invert.
G6_DIRECTION.critical_nuance: Initial direction is NOT the problem. first_direction_cosine is >= 0.9889 in all ten candidates and >= 0.99 in eight. What collapses is SUSTAINED radial sign agreement (0.438-0.750). A one-shot direction check at tick 0 would have missed this failure mode entirely; it is only visible by tracking across the horizon.
G6_DIRECTION.one_exception_worth_noting: GO_TO_HOME_WAYPOINT_SELF_CARRIER does not invert (radial 1.000), because home coincides exactly with a waypoint. Waypoint projection is harmless when the target happens to BE a waypoint, and pathological otherwise.

G6_TRAJECTORY.statement: Independent of target correctness in BOTH directions: GET_FLAG fails trajectory with a perfect 0.000 target, and G3 DEFEND passes trajectory with a 17-cell target error. These two facts together prove the sub-gates are genuinely independent and that neither can substitute for the other.
G6_TRAJECTORY.horizon_caveat: The 16-tick horizon systematically favors slow-moving roles. A defender does not travel far enough in 16 ticks for a wrong target to express itself positionally. Lengthening the horizon would make DEFEND look worse, not better, so the current horizon understates the DEFEND defect.

THE_THREE_ENGINEERING_PROBLEMS_NOW_SEPAR.1_vocabulary: DEFEND semantic target is not nameable. Fix = a new primitive. Scope: G3, G4.
THE_THREE_ENGINEERING_PROBLEMS_NOW_SEPAR.2_legality: GO_HOME is precondition-locked to carriers. Fix = a precondition change. Scope: G2 non-carrier.
THE_THREE_ENGINEERING_PROBLEMS_NOW_SEPAR.3_dynamics: Native Pyquaticus and this simulator integrate motion differently. Fix = out of scope for a vocabulary repair; report separately and do not relax the threshold. Scope: G1 GET_FLAG.
THE_THREE_ENGINEERING_PROBLEMS_NOW_SEPAR.plus_cross_cutting: Waypoint substitution inverts sustained direction whenever the true target is not itself a waypoint. This is why the new DEFEND primitive must NOT be built on the waypoint pathway.
